description: Alias of dogpolicies_get_rule, kept for older clients. One rule (a fee, a leash rule, a weight limit) by its stable id, with its value, the source it cites, the quote, its confidence, the date it was verified and its freshness, plus the place's citation line. Rule ids look like "rul_<place uid>_<kind>" and appear in every place result as rule_records.
